pages.text: $(l)Botania$() is a magic mod with no power system: flowers turn things into $(l)mana$(), and mana runs everything else. Nearly all of it is built from blocks and flowers rather than machines with GUIs.$(br2)Its materials come from mana infusion and ritual altars, neither of which is a crafting recipe.

Mana infusion and the ritual altars are not crafting recipes, so Botania's materials are priced by hand. They run $(l)Tier 3$() to $(l)Tier 6$(), from manasteel up to life essence behind the Gaia ritual.$(br2)Mana diamond is deliberately held below the vanilla diamond's tier, so infusing one is never a route to cheaper diamond-tier filament.
